November 8, 2026


From concerts and conventions to graduations and community celebrations,[TCU Place](https://facebook.com/117279694965301) has been part of Saskatoon's story for decades. Today, Cameco was proud and excited to become part of its next chapter as Cameco Centre through a new 10-year partnership. As CEO Tim Gitzel shared at the announcement, "We're not investing in a building. We're investing in what happens inside it. We're investing in a place that helps strengthen our community, showcases our city and creates experiences that build lasting memories." Here's to the memories still to come! #CommunityInvestment #Saskatoon[#TCUPlace](https://facebook.com/hashtag/TCUPlace)
